stories.title: Army to establish new autonomy command, acquisition executive
stories.why: The service’s new command will be called Army Futures and Autonomous Systems Command, or FASCOM, according to a memo signed by Acting Army Secretary Adam Telle.

stories.title: DHS readies major cyber contract

stories.title: Hegseth issues new directive to hasten U.S. military’s counter-drone pursuits
stories.why: The nation’s counter-drone task force “will not accept a slow-moving bureaucracy when faced with a fast-moving threat,” a spokesperson said.

stories.title: Long-range radar deal puts Ireland on course to shrink capability gap
